comparisons.comparison: Both QCOM and INTC discuss specific revenue growth drivers for their core product lines in fiscal 2024. QCOM attributes its 5% QTL revenue increase to higher estimated sales of 3G/4G/5G-based multimode products. Similarly, INTC attributes its 3% Intel Products revenue increase to higher revenue in specific segments, specifically Client Computing Group (CCG) and Data Center and AI (DCAI). While QCOM focuses on technology adoption (multimode connectivity) and INTC focuses on volume/demand shifts in end-markets (notebooks, high-core server products), both disclosures serve to explain the positive revenue variance in their respective primary business units.
